title: Park and restore legacy output without replacing destinations
summary: Read a built-in Pi worker's packet transcript through the operator tools, before and after the task is archived.

sections.title: What this ship changes for you
items: Read a built-in Pi worker's packet transcript through the operator tools, before and after the task is archived.
The built-in orchestrator's Full access commands stay inside the workspace, and a stopped orchestrator turn now ends visibly with the stop recorded.
A refused worker launch now says why and lists the valid runtime ids.
A late delivery confirmation removes its "may not have been delivered" warning, live and after reload, without touching other identical messages.
Inbox wakes keep their own reservation, so a failed send can no longer cancel a newer wake for the same agent.

The pull request list now syncs every open pull request up to 500 instead of the first page, keeps the previous list with a clear error when a sync fails, and no longer marks the whole list as failed when a single pull r
Repositories and projects added or changed through the server or CLI appear in the open window without a reload.
A failed update install is reported in the update card, the server and the console instead of failing silently.

sections.title: Features
items: Park and restore legacy output without replacing destinations
Renew local tokens for stopped private headless profiles
Add a per-run manual review hold for headless recovery
One OpenRouter connection with checked state, an off switch and plan-first billing

sections.title: Fixes
items: Stop leftover benchmark processes before the ship build
Paginate bounded pull request snapshots
Preserve inbox wake reservation ownership
Preserve failed prebuild output before fresh generation
Report a failed update apply to the server, the rail and the console
Keep lane Git checks and process probes off the server event loop
Show repositories and projects changed through the server in the open window
Preserve generated dependency links in legacy output
